name: Da Lat
provinceNote: Mui Ne shares Lam Dong on paper after the provincial merger. The coast is still a separate ride.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: A cool mountain town in the Central Highlands, with pine hills, flower gardens and a lake in the centre. See Bao Dai’s palace, the Crazy House and Datanla falls, drink highland coffee, and eat grilled rice paper at the night market. Two days suits couples, families and anyone escaping the heat.
fee: The lake is free. Palaces, gardens, and waterfalls ticket on their own.
getThere: Lien Khuong Airport (DLI), about 30 km south, with flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Da Lat travel guide — pine hills, lake, flowers, French villas
seoDescription: Pine hills, Xuan Huong Lake, flower festivals, and French villas in the cool southern highlands. Lien Khuong is about 30 km south. December to March is the dry window.
intro: Da Lat is the cool pine-hill town of the south: mist on Xuan Huong Lake in the morning, flower beds along the water, and French villas on the ridges. Walk the shore, then climb the market slope for strawberries, flowers, and a cup of avocado ice cream.
Stay when the cool highlands are the trip. Choose Nha Trang or Mui Ne when the sea is the reason; both are a few hours away by car, so treat each as its own trip.

The art-deco station, with DALAT across the yellow facade, runs a short tourist train toward Trai Mat and the mosaic pagoda at Linh Phuoc. Crazy House and Bao Dai Palace III fit between lake mornings. A clear morning is the cable car from Robin Hill over the pines to Truc Lam, or Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass. Lang Biang is the northbound half-day, and Elephant Falls at Nam Ban the longer ride out.
After dark the night market grills rice paper and pours hot soy milk, and the path around the lake stays lit. The lake is free; palaces, waterfalls, and gardens each sell their own ticket.
gettingAround: Lien Khuong Airport sits about 30 km south of town on National Highway 20, at Lien Nghia in Duc Trong, with flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City. Take a taxi or Grab into town. By road, Da Lat is about 293 km from Ho Chi Minh City and about 205 km from Nha Trang.

In town, walk the lake, Lam Vien Square, and the market. Use Grab or a taxi for Prenn Pass, Lang Biang, and Trai Mat. Motorbike touring is popular on the waterfall roads; ride yourself only with the proper licence. There is no passenger train into Da Lat. The station line is the tourist run to Trai Mat.

stayAreas.name: Around Xuan Huong Lake
stayAreas.summary: Walk to the market slope, Lam Vien Square, and the evening path along the water.

eat: Morning is bánh mì xíu mại or bánh căn, strawberries with condensed milk at the market, and a cold-cut banh mi from a counter. Evening is the night market for grilled rice paper and hot soy milk. Lunch can be lá é chicken hotpot. Coffee belongs to the Cau Dat hills.
interestsBody: Dining is bánh căn, bánh mì xíu mại, lá é chicken hotpot, market strawberries, and night-market rice paper.
Lakes, falls, and pine hills are Xuan Huong in town, then the cable car to Truc Lam, Datanla, Lang Biang, and Elephant Falls on half-day rides. Tuyen Lam is the reservoir south of town.
Flowers are Lam Vien Square beside the lake, the December festival displays, and the city flower garden at 2 Tran Nhan Tong.
The hill-station layer is the railway station, Bao Dai Palace III, the cathedral on Tran Phu, Domaine de Marie, the education college on Yersin, and Crazy House.
Coffee is Arabica country on the Cau Dat hills, with farm tours including K'Ho.
Shopping is the central market: flowers and farm fruit in the morning, and counters of jam, dried fruit, coffee, and artichoke tea to carry home.
Cool evenings are the night market and the lit walk around Xuan Huong.

interestGroups.title: Lakes, falls, and pine hills
interestGroups.summary: Xuan Huong is the lake in town. The cable car, Datanla, Lang Biang, and Elephant Falls are the rides out.

blocks.heading: The lake in town
paragraphs: Wake to mist on Xuan Huong and walk the shore; it costs nothing. Bring a layer from November to January, when the mornings turn chilly.

blocks.heading: South of town
paragraphs: A clear morning is the cable car from Robin Hill over the pines to Truc Lam, with Tuyen Lam Lake below the monastery. Datanla Falls is the other southbound stop, on Prenn Pass, with the alpine coaster and canyoning as faster ways down.

blocks.heading: North and further out
paragraphs: Lang Biang is the northbound half-day: a jeep or a hike from the gate at 93A Bidoup to viewpoints over the pine ridges. Elephant Falls, about 30 km away at Nam Ban, is the longer ride, for a wide curtain of water and a rocky path to its foot.

cards.summary: The city lake for a walk, a pedal boat, or a cool evening loop.

interestGroups.title: Flowers and gardens
interestGroups.summary: Lam Vien Square is the lakeside stage for the December flower festival.
body: The 11th Flower Festival opens at 20:00 on 19 December 2026 at Lam Vien Square and closes, with the New Year programme, at 20:00 on 31 December 2026. Flower displays run about 18 December 2026 through 3 January 2027 around Xuan Huong Lake and the central parks. The national tourism site lists the festival for December of odd years, so confirm later editions before you plan.
The city flower garden is a separate walk at 2 Tran Nhan Tong, open about 06:30–18:00, with adult tickets near 100,000 VND and children near 50,000 VND.

cards.summary: The lakeside square, and the flower-festival stage for December 2026.

blocks.heading: Station, villa, and churches
paragraphs: Start at the art-deco station with DALAT across the facade, then ride the tourist train toward Trai Mat. Crazy House, at 3 Huynh Thuc Khang, and Bao Dai Palace III, at 1 Trieu Viet Vuong, fit between lake mornings. The cathedral is the rooster tower on Tran Phu, Domaine de Marie the pink convent church at 1 Ngo Quyen, and the education college's curved colonnade the view from Yersin.

blocks.heading: The end of the line
paragraphs: Linh Phuoc, the mosaic pagoda at Trai Mat, is the stop at the end of the tourist train. Admission is free.

blocks.heading: Da Lat Market
paragraphs: Climb the sloping halls above Xuan Huong Lake in the morning. The flower hall is rows of cut stems, and the produce stalls sell the farm crops Da Lat is known for: strawberries, avocados, artichokes, and vegetables from the hills. Buy a cup of strawberries with condensed milk while you walk.
Entry is free. Check the stall scale before you pay for fruit, then carry it back down to the lake.

blocks.heading: Jam, tea, and wine to take home
paragraphs: Around the edge of the market, counters stack fruit preserves, candied ginger, coffee, and artichoke tea, the jars Da Lat is known for. Go early, when they set out. Dried persimmon from the Mimosa Pass orchards, strawberry jam, and Da Lat wine made from local grapes are the other gifts people carry home. Cao atiso, the cooked-down artichoke extract, is a separate jar from the tea.

blocks.heading: The night market
paragraphs: From about 18:00 to 23:00 the centre fills with stalls. Most of it is food, grilled rice paper, hot soy milk, and skewers, so treat it as the evening walk rather than a shopping trip, and arrive well before the stalls pack up.

Drink the cup after the lake walk, in town or out on the hills.

interestGroups.summary: When the coast is still hot, the lake path stays lit and the night market is up the slope.
body: The night market runs from about 18:00 to 23:00, grilling rice paper and pouring hot soy milk. The shore of Xuan Huong is the walk after that. Bring a layer from November to January.

cards.summary: The lake after the light drops, with lamps on the far shore.

season.label: Cool dry months
season.note: December to March is dry, cool, and sunny, with wild sunflowers on the hills in late autumn. Rain gathers from May to October, and a jumper helps from November to January. In 2026 the flower festival opens at 20:00 on 19 December at Lam Vien Square and closes at 20:00 on 31 December, with displays around the lake from 18 December through 3 January.

faqs.q: Where should you sleep in Da Lat?
faqs.a: Around Xuan Huong Lake, within a walk of the market slope and Lam Vien Square. A pine ridge above the lake is the quieter alternative.
The market slope: strawberries with condensed milk, banh mi from a counter, and hot soy milk. For a hot bowl, bánh mì xíu mại is the Da Lat breakfast.
The night market, from about 18:00 to 23:00, then the lit path around Xuan Huong Lake. It is a hill-town stroll, not a beach-bar strip.
The cable car from Robin Hill to Truc Lam, Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass, Lang Biang north of town by jeep or on foot, and Elephant Falls at Nam Ban, about 30 km away.

The 2026 festival opens at 20:00 on 19 December at Lam Vien Square and closes at 20:00 on 31 December, with displays around the lake from about 18 December 2026 to 3 January 2027. The national tourism site lists the festival for December of odd years, so confirm later dates before you plan.
